name: Thrill Wave
tagline: Real insight to real trust, captured on camera.
defaultDescription: Thrill Wave is a video production company in Phoenix, AZ. We research your world, find the story worth telling and film it with care.
summary: Thrill Wave is a video production company in Phoenix, Arizona. Before filming, the team runs a SITREP (situation report): deep research into the client's craft, peers, industry and sector, which works like an outside R&D department and helps decide which story is worth telling. Then they film it documentary-style and plan where it will be seen. Clients range from Fortune 500 companies to healthcare practices, nonprofits and tribal governments.
ogImageAlt: Thrill Wave logo over a close-up of a finger on a recorder's REC MODE button

team.name: Ari Everett
team.bio: Ari studied supply chain management at Arizona State University and spent more than 12 years running operations at some of the biggest companies in the world, including Diageo, Coca-Cola and Amazon. His love of tech and art led him to start Thrill Wave where business, tech and art meet. He runs every project the way the best companies run theirs, stays curious about how things work and brings the artistic fortitude to make work that lasts.

team.name: Tony Swann
team.jobTitle: Co-Founder, Director and Director of Photography
team.bio: Tony directs with patience and a big heart. He puts people at ease in front of the camera so the real moment shows up, and then he frames it with an artist's eye.

team.name: Chris Kuzman
team.bio: Chris asks the questions that get to the heart of things. He turns research into the story worth telling, so the work means something to the people it's made for.
